map.如何按不连续页码拆分？: How do I split non-contiguous pages?
map.在页码范围输入框用「1-3, 5, 7-10」格式描述：短横线表示连续区间、逗号: Describe the pages in the page range box with the format "1-3, 5, 7-10": a hyphen marks a continuous interval and commas separate segments, and the extraction order equals the order you type them in.
